svg.text: TOP-DOWN ZONE PLAN · PATHS, PLACES, LEVELS, AND TERRAIN TEXTURE
Root bridges and thorn paths close around the ravine. The
Warden's aggression blocks travel, yet the grove it guards
Blackbriar Lodge is a hunter hamlet. A few refuges and lookouts
support a sparse population of people who know the ravine paths.
Longhouse, raised walkways, rope bridges, lookout platforms,
lean-tos, and bark shelters. Hardwood, fungi, venom, and herbs
Root patterns bend around an old spring and buried stones. The
signs suggest a boundary, not what it was meant to keep in or
Levels are recommended encounter / quest bands.
